title: Pulp Fiction
description: Divided into 7 parts movie, presented in mixed order, by Quentin Tarantino became the second one in my [X] Filmography Marathon. Inglorious Basterds was something so great I decided I HAVE to watch his other movies and here we are. Starting with a scene in some diner in the sunny state of California with a lovely couple's small talk about how safe it is to rob a cafe. So calm and cozy scene I can kill myself. I really like prologue and epilogue. They feel like great opening and ending for a show. Movie's length is damn 2.5 hours long, but it went so smoothly I didn't even notice it's already almost over. The scene where Jules points his gun at Ringo woke me up. Reference made in Chainsawman Opening 1 instantly came to my mind. I hadn't known it was a reference to this movie until that moment. Really like Winston Wolf and this idiot duo. And really-really like this movie. It goes without (kinda) saying - 10 out of 10.
